remarks: A rare opportunity to own a truly exceptional property that is private, picturesque and lovingly cared for by its owners for many years. Set on a peaceful cul-de-sac in a charming village setting, this exceptional tri-level residence offers the perfect blend of timeless character, modern comfort, and an enviable lifestyle. With 4 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, the spacious and versatile layout provides room to live, gather, and grow. At the heart of the home is an updated gourmet chef’s kitchen, complete with a spacious casual dining area, beautifully appointed for effortless entertaining and everyday enjoyment. A gracious formal dining room adds an elegant touch for memorable dinners and celebrations, while the expansive living room offers the perfect setting for relaxing or hosting special gatherings. Abundant closet and storage space throughout ensures both beauty and functionality. You'll find the versatile layout provides potential for an in-law suite or private guest accommodations. Beyond the living spaces lies a truly remarkable private retreat. Situated on a large, deep double lot, the expansive grounds offer a special sense of space and seclusion. The centerpiece is an inground heated saltwater pool—an inviting oasis for summer gatherings, quiet afternoons, and unforgettable evenings under the stars. Enjoy the peaceful sights and sounds of nature from the comfort of your backyard sanctuary. The attached 2.5-car garage provides exceptional convenience along with generous storage for vehicles, equipment, and hobbies. Ideally located close to the lake and local amenities, this property offers the rare opportunity to enjoy village charm, everyday convenience, and a private resort-like setting all in one. A home filled with warmth, pride of ownership, and the kind of character that can only be created over time. This is more than a house—it is a place to create the next chapter of your story.
